scenario: Loan term outside permitted product range
description: Requested loan term exceeds the maximum permitted term for Personal Loan.
detection_rule: requested_term must be between product min_term and max_term.

scenario: Repayment schedule financial values fail principal/schedule reconciliation
description: Principal amount does not reconcile with the installment amount and opening-to-closing balance.
detection_rule: principal_amount + interest_amount must equal installment_amount; opening_balance - principal_amount must equal closing_balance.

scenario: Decision date before required assessment timestamps
description: Decision was recorded before both the affordability check and credit assessment were completed.
detection_rule: Decision.decision_date must be on or after both AffordabilityCheck.checked_at and CreditAssessment.assessed_at.

description: Two verified income records from different sources are effective on the application date, with a 53.3% difference in monthly income.
detection_rule: For the same applicant, two VERIFIED income records from different sources are effective on the application date and differ by more than 10%.

description: Two successful disbursement records exist for the same approved loan application.
detection_rule: An approved application must not have more than one successful disbursement.
